prompt: # BUILD PROMPT — Landing Page: "DRAFTING ROOM — CASA LUMEN · A-101" **Your Role:** Act as a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Deliver a complete, production-quality, single-page landing site **on the first attempt** — all sections, all component states, both themes, fully functional. The design language is an industrial/technical drafting-room aesthetic (2020s contemporary) for a precision architecture offering: "DRAFTING ROOM — CASA LUMEN · A-101". Every rule below is mandatory. --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE **1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS** * All styling must live exclusively in `style.css`. The `style="..."` attribute is **forbidden** anywhere in the HTML. * Style only through class/ID selectors. Markup must remain semantic and styling-agnostic — a full retheme must be achievable by editing CSS alone. * No `!important`, no presentational tags (``, ``, ``), no inline event handlers. **1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens** Define all tokens in `:root` (Light) and override them for Dark (Rule 1.3). Map the given palette as follows: * Light (`:root`): `--primary: #b3412b` (oxide red — CTAs, accents, annotations); `--secondary: #8d8264` (bronze); `--bg-primary: #f3ecd9` (parchment); `--bg-secondary: #ece3cb` (aged paper — cards, wells); `--text-primary: #2b2620` (ink); `--text-secondary: #8d8264` (verify ≥ 4.5:1 for small text; darken within the same hue, e.g., toward `#6a5f47`, if it fails); `--text-error` / `--border-error: #b3412b` family (darken to ≈ `#9c331f` if contrast requires); `--text-success` / `--border-success`: a muted moss green harmonized with the palette (≈ `#4e6b45`), AA-compliant; `--border-default: rgba(43,38,32,0.18)`; `--bg-footer: #221d15` paired with `--text-on-footer: #f3ecd9`. **Never use pure white**; if a near-white is required, use `#fefefe`. * Required structural tokens: `--radius-sm: 4px`, `--radius-md: 8px`, `--radius-lg: 16px`; `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md`, plus a neumorphic pair `--shadow-neu-out` (e.g., `8px 8px 16px rgba(43,38,32,0.18), -8px -8px 16px rgba(254,254,254,0.7)`) and `--shadow-neu-in` (inverted); `--spacing-gap: 1.25rem`; `--transition-fast: 150ms`; `--transition-normal: 300ms`; `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`; `--z-dropdown: 100`, `--z-modal: 200`, `--z-toast: 300`, `--z-header: 90`; `--font-heading`, `--font-base`, `--font-mono`. * **Contrast pairing:** every light background token pairs with a dark text token and every dark background token pairs with a light text token — in **both** themes, no exceptions. **1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support** * Dark Mode must be **fully defined and fully usable** even though Light is this theme's default. Provide tokens under both a `.dark` class on `` and `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`. Switching themes must never require HTML restructuring. * Dark overrides: `--bg-primary: #221d15`, `--bg-secondary: #2b2620`, `--text-primary: #f3ecd9`, `--text-secondary: ≈ #cdc2a4` (AA on dark), `--primary: ≈ #d1553c` (brightened oxide), `--border-default: rgba(243,236,217,0.16)`, `--bg-footer: #1a1611` with `--text-on-footer: #f3ecd9`. Neumorphic shadows switch to deep-black/soft-light variants so surfaces stay visible. * **Persistence:** store the user's choice in `localStorage` (key `casa-lumen-theme`). Provide a **visible theme toggle** in the site header using Google Material Symbols (`dark_mode` / `light_mode`), with `aria-pressed` reflecting state and a dynamically updated `aria-label` ("Activate dark mode" / "Activate light mode"). * **Default-Mode Exception (explicit):** Per the source style specification, Light Mode is this theme's primary presentation — on a first visit with no stored preference, render **Light Mode**, overriding the `prefers-color-scheme` fallback; all other persistence behavior remains unchanged. **1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment** * Build every layout with Flexbox. Every flex container **must default to `align-items: center`**; the only sanctioned exceptions (justify each with a code comment): equal-height card rows (Features, Steps, Pricing, Testimonials) using `align-items: stretch`, and full-height hero stretch. * Mobile-first: all rows collapse to columns on small viewports; **zero horizontal scrolling** at any width (validate at 320px). One centered container (max-width ≈ 72rem) with fluid inline padding. **1.5 CSS Approach & Naming Convention** * Use clean, hand-authored modern CSS in `style.css`, organized with native `@layer` (tokens → base → layout → components → utilities). Do not load the Tailwind CDN; if any utility is used it must map back to the tokens. * One convention only: **BEM** (`block__element--modifier`) — e.g., `.hero`, `.hero__title`, `.card--featured`, `.btn--primary`. Never mix conventions. **1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)** * Google Fonts via `` (one combined request, `display=swap`, with `preconnect`): **Archivo** (headings, 600/700 — strong, industrial), **Inter** (body, 400/500), **IBM Plex Mono** (technical annotations, labels, numerals). Bind to `--font-heading`, `--font-base`, `--font-mono`. * Icons: **Google Material Symbols (Outlined)** via the official stylesheet. Raw inline SVGs and local icon files are **forbidden**. Decorative icons get `aria-hidden="true"`; meaningful icons carry accessible labels. --- ## 2.
